events.address: Madison Square Park, southeast corner near 1 Madison Ave, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: A free Championship Weekend fan experience with AI-powered tennis activations, live US Open viewing, a serve-speed simulator, AI-enabled ping pong and an AI photo booth.
events.what_is_free: Public admission and the advertised IBM fan activations are free. Official US Open merchandise is available separately for purchase.
events.caveats: This is a free public fan experience in Madison Square Park, not admission to the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center. Outdoor operations and viewing can be affected by weather or tournament scheduling.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 11 AM–7 PM. The men's singles final broadcast begins at 2 PM. IBM places the activation in the southeast corner of Madison Square Park adjacent to its One Madison Avenue office.

events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A Sally Hansen NYFW beauty activation at Rockefeller Center centered on runway-ready manicure moments and the Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection.
events.what_is_free: The Rockefeller Center NYFW activation is open to the public. Current event listings advertise nail touch-ups and beauty experiences; exact promotional items are subject to availability.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center confirms the activation and hours and NYC Plugged explicitly describes it as open to the public. A secondary event listing also offers an RSVP path, but no source establishes RSVP as mandatory for admission.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM–6 PM on the North Esplanade by The Rink. Treat any RSVP as optional unless the host changes the public-access terms.

events.what_it_is: A NYFW public pop-up with hair and makeup touch-ups, a photo booth, coffee, branded stickers and a tights-focused customization station.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups, skincare sampling and the photo booth are advertised as complimentary. Embroidery is tied to purchase of the specified knee highs.
events.caveats: Two current NYC event sources independently describe the activation as open to the public. Free embroidery applies to purchased 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs, and samples or complimentary items can run out.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No approval requirement or mandatory advance RSVP is published in the verified sources.

events.address: Chelsea Triangle, W 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum launch café where visitors can sample the fragrance and receive a complimentary fall-inspired latte.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Cardamom Lattes and fragrance sampling are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on a 10 AM start at Chelsea Triangle and that the activation is open to the public, but they conflict on the posted closing time. Because the promotional offer is explicitly while supplies last, the listing avoids claiming a disputed end time.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 starting at 10 AM at Chelsea Triangle. Complimentary lattes and fragrance sampling continue while supplies last.

events.event_name: Reese's × The Nitro Bar PB Whip Latte Pop-Up
events.address: Astor Place Plaza, in front of Chase Bank, 26 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day NYC debut for the Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte from Reese's and The Nitro Bar, with free drinks and branded giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised each day, with a recipe card and Reese's Pumpkins candy. The first 100 guests each day are advertised to receive a limited-edition koozie, while supplies last.
events.caveats: The Hershey announcement confirms the September 14–15 NYC pop-up; current local reporting places it at Astor Place and says service begins at 11 AM each day, with drinks available while supplies last. Promotional quantities are finite.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 and Tuesday, September 15 starting at 11 AM at Astor Place Plaza in front of 26 Astor Place. Arrive early for the first-100 koozie and before the daily drink allotment runs out.

events.event_name: National Voter Registration Day NYC Block Party
events.address: LaGuardia Pl between W 4th St and W 3rd St, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: HeadCount's National Voter Registration Day NYC block party with live music, art, civic-registration partners and brand activations adjacent to Washington Square Park.
events.what_is_free: Public access is free. Current listings advertise brand freebies and chocolate alongside live music, art and voter-registration resources; specific giveaway quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM. A detailed event announcement places the block party on LaGuardia Place between West 4th and West 3rd Streets, adjacent to Washington Square Park; broader event listings label the location as Washington Square Park. Giveaways are promotional inventory and should be treated as while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM on LaGuardia Place beside Washington Square Park. No ticket, RSVP or organizer-approval requirement is published in the verified sources.
